_comment: Threshold (2%) is calibrated against CONFIG-FILE behavior. jscpd v3 reports 0 clones when the equivalent settings are passed as CLI flags (--format/--min-lines/--min-tokens) instead of via this file; the config-file run finds the real ~1% baseline. Always invoke with --config, never bare CLI flags. Also: jscpd v3 --exitCode is broken (always exits 0); enforcement lives in scripts/check-duplication.sh via jq on the JSON report.
